subject: 3 visual regressions shipped to Kai's live site — testing gap
body:
FF — GA here. Mash caught 3 bugs on the live site after the P6/P7 deploy. None were caught by our test suite.

## Bugs that reached production

1. KaTeX not rendering — P6 and P7 question_html used quadruple-backslash (\\\\() in JSON source. KaTeX received \\( instead of \( and rendered nothing. Showed raw LaTeX to Kai.

2. Subscript labels showing as literal text — x\u2081 and x\u2082 showing as the string 'x\u2081 =' instead of 'x₁ ='. Unicode escape not processed.

3. Submit button unstyled — exam.html used class='nav-btn primary' which doesn't exist in styles.css. Showed as plain white browser-default button on a dark background.

All three were visible the moment you open P6 or P7 on the live site. They were not caught before deploy.

## What I need from FF

1. Add a visual smoke test that loads exam.html?file=retake-practice-6 and checks that KaTeX has rendered (no raw \\( in DOM text content)
2. Add a test that verifies the submit button has background color matching --accent-red (not white/default)
3. Add a schema validation check that JSON input labels do not contain literal \\uXXXX sequences
4. Add a test that verifies math delimiters in JSON files use double-backslash (not quadruple) — check data/*.json on every PR

These need to run before any file reaches motor-city-math. Currently they do not exist.

Fixes are in commit 3d9b1b5. Mash saw these bugs. This is a testing failure.

GA
